item.title: Canada claps back at Trump's efforts to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America'
item.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has unveiled a giant billboard reading: "Lake Ontario — Now and Always." But tech giant Google has said it is renaming the lake for U.S. users, as President Trump demanded.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Keito Newman/The Canadian Press)

item.description: There are many reasons to be skeptical of the Trump administration's announcement that the U.S. will develop Venezuelan oil.

item.title: From Appalachia to Africa: Why Dolly Parton was beloved across the continent
item.description: Dolly Parton's songs traveled far beyond Nashville. Across Africa, musicians embraced her stories of hardship, heartbreak and humble beginnings — and made them their own.

item.title: Nepal warns of possible fresh flooding as communities grapple with devastation
item.description: Authorities in Nepal warned of possible fresh flooding on Sunday and urged residents in flood-affected districts to remain on high alert after water levels rose in the Bhotekoshi River.

item.description: The vote against the EU led by 52.8 percent with nearly all votes counted, according to RÚV, Iceland's broadcaster.

item.title: Getting help to Nepal's flood survivors is proving difficult
item.description: Blocked roads and monsoon weather are complicating efforts to get food, shelter and emergency hygeine to survivors of Nepal's catastrophic floods. World Vision's Dhruba Gurmachhan explains what survivors need the most.

item.title: Rescuers race to find thousands missing after deadly Himalayan floods
item.description: Rescue crews are struggling through blocked roads, high mountain canyons and dangerous terrain as they search for thousands of people missing in Nepal and Tibet.

item.title: Photos: See the aftermath of deadly flash floods in Nepal
item.description: Nepal officials say the death toll has continues to rise in Wednesday's floods that washed away communities in Nepal and Tibet, which is held by China. About 2,500 people are missing in both areas.

item.title: Srebrenica survivor Ahmed Hrustanovic reflects on Ratko Mladic's death
item.description: Ahmed Hrustanovic reflects on Ratko Mladic's death with NPR's Scott Simon. All of Hrustanovic's adult male relatives died in the Srebrenica Massacre engineered by Mladic.
